reviewer: independent reviewer /root/labels; did not author the advanced-A source/solutions/models
method: Manually read every contact sheet a-001.jpg through a-033.jpg, all 130 representative PNGs, and all 8 listed full-page context PNGs.
Verified SHA-256 of all 190 model screenshot files against the manifest; a duplicate carries visual evidence only because its bytes are identical.
Checked label/point correspondence, sector placement, line and angle markings, clipping, introductions of construction points, alternate cases, and disclosure state.
Source/proof/coordinate review is separately recorded in ATANASYAN_7_9_ADVANCED_A_REVIEW.md.

After the final candidate capture completed, reused 141 previously inspected image states only by exact SHA-256 equality, and manually inspected all 29 fresh representatives for the 49 changed states in delta-001.jpg through delta-008.jpg. Rechecked all final file hashes and bound them to the completed browser evidence and immutable bundle snapshot.

snapshot.modelHashNote: The snapshot predates the acute-triangle correction to 426. Current model bytes are not inferred from image filenames.

findings.description: On the 320 px actual lesson screenshots, sector label 2 was placed below the horizontal ray next to O, outside its intended 0–25 degree sector. The collision checker alone did not detect this semantic error.
findings.resolution: All 8 final 416 view/width pairs inspected through 6 fresh unique PNGs; every number is in its intended sector, including the transferred upper 3/4. No clipping or overlap observed.

findings.description: This snapshot still shows the obsolete obtuse A=(0,3.4) triangle for both 426 cards, contrary to the acute source conditions. These screenshots are rejected, even where labels are readable.
findings.resolution: All 16 final 426a/426b view/width pairs inspected through 4 fresh unique PNGs. Both now show the reviewed acute triangle with legible A/B/C and angle arcs.

findings.description: The final neutral and final-answer views place M inside ABC beside its point. In construction steps 2–4, automatic avoidance of AN places M beyond AB. The interior point remains visible and uniquely identifiable; no labels intersect, clip or disappear.
findings.resolution: Nonblocking after manual inspection at both widths. The frozen candidate is accepted with this explicit layout observation; no further change is required for this review.

observations: 413–415 and 419–424: units, fractions, angle/length marks, and construction labels are legible at both widths.
417/418: conditional configurations are explicitly identified, line labels are associated with their lines, and R is visible at its introduction.
425: all three exterior cases remain legible at 320 px; figures are small because of common bounds, but labels do not overlap or misidentify vertices.
427: median/half-base marks and acute/right/obtuse cases agree with the explanations.
428/429: introduced auxiliary edges are separated by steps, and no answer is printed into the neutral figure.
The eight initial full pages have readable source captions, full statements and controls, with no visible horizontal clipping.
